name: Lingua Time
summary: Smart date and time picker for shadcn/ui that understands natural language input.
description: A date and time picker component for shadcn/ui that understands natural language input, pulled into your project as a single registry item. It can be wired to react-hook-form, is MIT licensed, and has a live demo at linguatime.nainglinnkhant.com.
contains: understands natural language date and time input
